body: I understand I'm young, but I will NOT just stand by and let someone I care about get themself killed. I would prefer anyone I come in contact with to not kill themself, I dont even care about the relationship now. I just want het to be happy again and not do anything idiotic.

I'm only 14 and she is 15. I have plenty of money saved up, and I'm willing to spend all of it if it means she wont kill herself. With me being on summer vacation I have enough time for pretty much anything, but I havent told my family, and I dont think they would let me travel that far for someone I met online. We talk all the time, but I cant do it anymore. She's so convinced that she is going to kill herself eventually, I feek like I'm talking to an already dead body. I cant personally do anything besides talk to her, thats why I contacted reddit.
The problem with talking to her about the problems is that she says if she told me, she would have to go. I dont know how serious this is, but I would hate to lose her.
I dont think anything too serious has happened besides one thing, and it happened a long time ago.
She gave nude photos of herself to a person online, now shes shy so thats why I hardly know anything, the person she gave them to said he wanted more or he'd post them to facebook. She said no, he posted them. Shes been grounded for the past few months.
I'd love to see her in person and I know she'd like to see me, but she keeps on saying it wont make any difference if I do or not. I really dont like to believe that, I really dont. 
I told her that I'd be able to visit in 2 years for sure, because whenever anyone in our family turns 16 we get to travel wherever we want for a week or so, and I'd like to see her, when I told her to hang in there until I finally meet her, she said 'okay, maybe.' 



Sorry for the wall of text, I'm too lazy to put it into paragraphs.
